name: clean-room
description: A clean-room compatibility implementation workflow with separated specification, implementation, and verification roles.

interface.shortDescription: Build compatible software across an explicit information barrier.
interface.longDescription: Coordinates a black-box observation and specification phase, an isolated implementation phase that receives only approved artifacts, and a fresh-context conformance review. The workflow records provenance and distinguishes observed behavior from inference, but does not replace legal review or operating-system-level isolation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $clean-room-implementation to build a compatible implementation from black-box behavior.
